topics.topic: Required-test action coverage for A04-3 and A04-6 revision and no-change guarantees
questions: Must the witness show A04-3 and A04-6 for every applicable revision-moving or no-change action, or are project correction, Customer correction, restriction and no-op correction intended as representative samples? The item does not say what must be shown for lifting a restriction, ending or resuming a relationship, or their no-change forms.

Which Required tests must show A04-3 for every accepted changing action in its quantified scope? The listed checks cover project correction and archiving, Customer correction and restriction, but do not say that lifting a restriction, ending a relationship or resuming it must each move the Customer revision exactly once and set its last-changed instant to the current instant.
Must the A04-3 witness show the guarantee for every accepted Customer change that retains a revision—correction, restriction, lifting, ending and resuming—or only for correction and restriction?
Which no-change actions must the A04-6 witness cover, beyond corrections and repeated archiving, to show the invariant for every accepted no-change action on a Project or Customer?

for action a on record r in {Project, Customer} that may move r.revision:

judgement.divergence: An implementation in which lifting, ending or resuming a Customer relationship moves the revision and last-changed instant satisfies A04-3; one that leaves either value unmoved violates A04-3, yet A04 Required test 11 can pass because it expressly exercises only correction and restriction, which the owner can detect by reading the Customer after the omitted action.
judgement.why: A04-3 is universally quantified over revision-retaining changes, but its Required tests do not say that lifting, ending and resuming must be shown, while A05's no-change tests are bound only to A05-1 rather than saying that they show A04-6.
options: Require coverage of every action to which the universally quantified invariants A04-3 and A04-6 apply.
Add separately bound Required tests for the omitted actions and bind the existing A05 no-change cases to A04-6 as applicable.
Narrow A04-3 and A04-6 to a smaller explicit action set, reconciling that change with State 1.
consequences: Exhaustive or separately bound coverage shows the accepted revision and no-change guarantees for lifting, ending and resuming; representative-only coverage can admit code that violates those guarantees outside correction and restriction; narrowing the invariant would weaken an accepted State 1 obligation.

topics.topic: UTC wall-clock reading count and shared instant value for an accepted revision-moving operation
questions: How many UTC wall-clock readings does one accepted revision-moving operation take, and is one reading shared by the record's last-changed instant, the audit entry's instant and any other instants written by that operation?

How many UTC wall-clock readings does one accepted operation take, and must the same reading supply the record's last-changed instant, its audit-entry instant and every other fresh recorded instant written by that operation?
How many UTC wall-clock readings does one accepted operation take, and which written instants share the resulting value?

quotes:
An action has one instant: `operations` reads it from
  `clock.recorded_now` once, when the action's transaction begins, takes
  today's date as that instant's UTC date itself, so the two cannot fall on
  different dates at midnight, and hands both to every module the
  action records a new instant or compares a date in.

Every action that changes the store is one transaction `operations` opens
through `store` (A04 rule 4), taking the one write lock when it begins; every
agent-authority call takes it too, a read included (A10 rule 6). Inside it
`operations` reads the action's one instant from `clock`, takes today's date
as that instant's UTC date, and hands both on ("Time"), the record's module writes, and `operations` appends
the one audit entry when the action changed state and M09 lists it (A14
rule 1), naming the release and contract versions, and commits once.
judgement.why: P6 judged the same shared-clock-reading question on the same texts, and the quoted later-state passages have not changed.
options: Take one UTC wall-clock reading and reuse it for every instant written by the operation
Take separate readings for the record and audit entry
consequences: The deciding State 3 text selects the first option.

judgement.divergence: If two successive changes of one Customer occur before the UTC clock yields a different representable value, storing that same value twice makes the revision move while the last-changed value does not; waiting, clamping or using a sufficiently discriminating reading makes the second value move, which a reader of the two revisions can distinguish.
judgement.why: State 2 requires revision and last-changed to move exactly together and assigns `now`, but it does not decide whether equal successive wall-clock readings are permitted or how a later representable instant is obtained when they are not.
options: Require a wall-clock representation and source that yield a strictly later representable instant for every successive change.
Allow equal timestamp values for successive revisions when the clock has not advanced.
Clamp or wait for a representable instant after the previous last-changed value.
consequences: A strict-later rule preserves the stated pairing of revision movement and last-changed movement; allowing equality weakens that observable guarantee; clamping or waiting preserves ordering but must reconcile the manufactured or delayed value with A04-3's literal `now`.

topics.topic: Whether non_editable excludes revision and last-changed fields
questions: Does non_editable exclude revision and last-changed instant, which are not correction inputs but must change under A04 when the correction changes editable facts?

judgement.why: A03 rule 3 defines the unchanged non-editable facts explicitly and separately directs revision and last-changed to A04, so those two fields are excluded from A03-2's unchanged set.
options: Define non_editable as identity, status, marks, created instant and request id, excluding revision and last-changed instant.
Include revision and last-changed instant among non_editable facts.
consequences: The first interpretation is expressly selected and permits A04 to move revision and last-changed on a changing correction; the second contradicts the answering passage.

author_guidance: Before editing, identify the decision's owning state from the phase purpose, question_scope and layer obligations, then choose a disposition for each topic that awaits one.
fixed: repair a decision the owning state must make; do not add later-layer implementation choices merely to close a topic. Record the fix commit and review the changed text once.

carried: name the receiving layer and use --what to preserve the choice, its options and consequences, and the required guarantee every option must keep. Decide any guarantee owned here before carrying its execution onward.
accepted: explain why the remaining choice is permitted. Bring an unresolved product choice to the owner with its options and consequences; absence of a quoted requirement does not decide it.
contradiction and standard_violation take no disposition: repair the offending text in its owning state and review the change. Deterministic transition findings must also close through their checks.
State 2: decide required results and constraints, including necessary refusal precedence; carry test mechanisms, exact contracts and deployment procedures to their owners.
